svg.title: A planned step test on the heater
svg.desc: After a qualified 5 second baseline at 75 percent, the command steps to 85 percent for 30 seconds. The temperature starts rising 1.1 seconds after the step, reaches 95 percent of its change 16 seconds after the step and 36.994 degrees Celsius, 99.7 percent, at the end of the hold; the record lasts 35.1 seconds.
svg.text: A planned step test: steady start, 10-point step, 30 s hold
Control Studio recording of this project · baseline checked before the step · numbers answer the predictions
36.994 °C at the end of the hold
First rise 1.1 s after the step: 0.4 °C/s
